title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E3 — Rock Bottom
Addiction leads prisoners to serious crime to fuel their habits.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Blue Balloons
A young couple comes to jail after a crime spree, but their stories don't add up; one of the jail's most prolific contraband smugglers makes her return, but staff cracks down on the pipeline.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Killing Clouds
An online post from a diehard Dodgers fan leads to his arrest at a Reds game; a tragic shooting leaves one inmate facing prison time and outrage over his punishment leads to more arrests.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Pros and Cons
A low-level offender increases his sentence from 18 months to 16-and-a-half years after three separate counts of aggravated battery on an officer; the same inmate was banned from even non-contact visits after an affair with a prison staff nurse.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Fight or Flight
The Penitentiary of New Mexico houses both low level and max-security inmates; Level 6 inmates like Chris Shiverdecker, who has a MacGyver-like prison reputation, are still eligible for hearings that could change custody level and security status.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Institutionalized
Inmates who become disruptive at the Penitentiary of New Mexico are transferred to the lock-up units in level 5 or 6; the trouble is, their behavior doesn't always improve; this is a lesson rookie officer Amy Lee is learning the hard way.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Miss Fortune
A troubled young inmate, recently sentenced to prison, attempts to make a final impression on staff; a young woman who gave birth in the jail watches her baby grow up without her.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Next of Kin
The jail responds with force after an officer is assaulted and inmates attempt escape; an 18-year-old shoots her father to death then finds a surrogate mother on the inside.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Company You Keep
An inmate with suspicious tax forms becomes a problem for the jail, and a murder ends with the victim burned alive in a dumpster, pitting friends and family against each other.
